entries.title: II Chronicles 10:4
segments: Expensive undertakings of rulers necessarily bring heavy burdens on the people, under which they become uneasy, and from which they wish to be delivered.

entries.title: II Chronicles 10:7
segments: Kindness in rulers often does more to secure obedience from the people, than force; and the longer men live, and the more they see of their fellow men, the deeper is their conviction of this truth.

entries.title: II Chronicles 10:10
segments: Youth are reckless, and often plunge into courses which bring distress and ruin upon themselves and others.

entries.title: II Chronicles 10:15
segments: The hand of God is never to be overlooked in the events of his providence, but is to be acknowledged even in those calamities which the folly and wickedness of men bring upon themselves.

entries.title: II Chronicles 10:17
segments: Rehoboam reigned over them; and also over the tribe of Benjamin, which was joined to that of Judah.
